name: Credit
overview: Scripture teaches that God blesses His people so they may lend to others rather than borrow, highlighting a position of financial stability and blessing (Deuteronomy 15:6; 28:12). The righteous are characterized by integrity in financial dealings, repaying what they owe and showing mercy, in contrast to the wicked who borrow without repaying (Psalms 37:21). Wisdom in managing resources involves preserving wealth rather than spending foolishly, and maintaining a good name is valued above riches (Proverbs 13:22; 21:20; 22:1). These principles guide believers to steward credit responsibly, reflecting trustworthiness and godly character.
